summary: Kootenai County, ID site: camp 1922, log cupola cabin built 1924, destroyed about 1950 and listed gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Log cupola cabin; two patrol points nearby
facts.status_note: Destroyed about 1950 (firelookout.com) or in the 1950s (Idaho Fire Lookouts); listed as gone by firelookout.org

staffing.status: one name listed on Idaho Fire Lookouts: Miles Standish, 1929 (citing Bert Russell)

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site hike-in; no source read describes the route or what remains at the site

events.note: Miles Standish listed for 1929 on Idaho Fire Lookouts, citing Bert Russell
About 1950 per firelookout.com; the 1950s per Idaho Fire Lookouts

evidence.supports: camp established 1922; log cupola cabin built 1924; destroyed about 1950
evidence.quote: Established as a camp in 1922, this log cupola cabin, built in 1924, was destroyed about 1950.

evidence.supports: two patrol points, one mile southeast and 2.5 miles east, atop Leiberg Peak
evidence.quote: There were also patrol points one mile southeast and 2.5 miles east atop Leiberg Peak.

evidence.supports: location 13 miles east of Hayden Lake in Kootenai County
elevation 5,292 feet on the Coeur d'Alene National Forest

evidence.quote: Two patrol points: One mile southeast and also 2.5 miles east atop Leiberg Peak.

evidence.quote: Miles Standish (North Fork of the Coeur d'Alene by Bert Russell)

notes_for_editor: Coordinates disagree in the brief: the firelookout.org record gives 47.78145, -116.39107 and the Idaho Fire Lookouts-derived record gives 47.77519, -116.38213, about 1 km apart. firelookout.com gives only '13 miles east of Hayden Lake' and no coordinates, so neither set is confirmed here; no correction proposed. Destruction date differs in wording (about 1950 vs 1950s), both kept. The brief's 'ground' kind matches the cabin description. Both lookout pages credit the Fire Lookout Museum for a photo, but no photo URL was recorded as a new find. Idaho Fire Lookouts' 'Hike-in' label is kept as a note only.
